body:
💰 SchoolEco - The Ultimate SMP Economy Mod

Transform your Minecraft server into a fully featured economy experience with custom shops, player trading, auctions, orders, homes, teleport menus, and much more!

SchoolEco is designed for SMP servers that want a simple but powerful economy system without needing multiple different mods. Everything is connected together through easy-to-use menus and commands.

✨ Features
💵 Economy System
Player balances
Money transfers between players
Admin money management
Custom starting balance
Formatted money display
1,000 = 1k
1,000,000 = 1m
1,000,000,000 = 1b
And beyond!
🛒 Shop System
Sell items directly from your inventory
Sell hand
Sell all
Custom item prices
Search items instantly
Easy-to-use GUI menus
OP price editing menu
🍎 Food Shop
Dedicated food shop GUI
Buy common food items quickly
Simple and clean menu
Easy price customization
📦 Orders System

Create buy orders for items and let other players fulfill them.

Create orders
Claim completed orders
Automatic payouts
Safe inventory handling
No item loss when inventory is full
🔨 Auction House
List items for sale
Buy items from other players
Browse pages of listings
Search functionality
SMP-style marketplace
🏠 Multi Home System
Home 1
Home 2
Home 3
Home deletion
Home management GUI
🌍 Teleport System
Teleport requests
Player teleport GUI
Home teleportation
Teleport countdown
Movement cancellation
Damage cancellation
📊 GUI-Based Experience

Most features can be accessed through menus instead of commands.

Open the main menu and manage:

Economy
Orders
Shops
Auction House
Teleports
Homes
Prices

All from one place.

⚙️ Designed For SMP Servers

SchoolEco was built specifically for SMP gameplay and works great for:

🏰 Survival Servers
👥 Friend Groups
🌎 Public SMPs
⚔️ Community Servers
🎮 Long-Term Worlds

🚀 Performance
Lightweight design
Fast data storage
Fabric optimized
Compatible with modern Fabric servers
❤️ Why Download SchoolEco?

Instead of installing 5–10 separate mods for economy, homes, auctions, orders, and shops, SchoolEco combines everything into one connected system.

✔️ Economy
✔️ Shops
✔️ Orders
✔️ Auction House
✔️ Homes
✔️ Teleports
✔️ GUI Menus
